summary: This sermon on Psalm 133 explores Christian unity as a witness to a divided world. The preacher argues that true unity is not uniformity or avoidance of disagreement, but rather diverse believers united around the gospel of Jesus, becoming like sweet-smelling oil and refreshing water to those around them.
key_points: Unity among God's people should be rare and noticeable to the world, like pleasant perfume
True unity brings together diverse people around the gospel, not just those who agree on everything
Unity requires the miraculous work of the Holy Spirit and is a foretaste of heaven
Distinguish between closed-handed essentials (Christ's death and resurrection) and open-handed issues where Christians can disagree
Intentionally seek relationships with believers who have different perspectives
big_idea: Christian unity amid diversity, centered on the gospel of Jesus Christ, serves as a powerful witness to an isolated and divided world.
title: Psalm 133
